# Crazy SEO Team

> AI SEO, semantic SEO, NLP, GEO, AEO, LLM optimization, digital growth, ANVYA Ideas and moderated classifieds.

## Canonical website
https://crazyseoteam.in/

## Primary pages
- https://crazyseoteam.in/ — AI SEO and digital growth platform.
- https://crazyseoteam.in/services — SEO, AI SEO, technical SEO, content and automation services.
- https://crazyseoteam.in/seo-tools — SEO audit, metadata, schema, sitemap, NLP, AEO, GEO and LLM-oriented tools.
- https://crazyseoteam.in/ai-tools — AI-assisted SEO, content and marketing workflows.
- https://crazyseoteam.in/ideas — ANVYA public ideas, questions, discussions and events.

## ANVYA Ideas
ANVYA is a public discovery and discussion area covering AI, SEO, technology, travel, science and economics. Approved public posts may be indexed and referenced. Account, profile and posting controls are separate from public discovery pages.

## Classifieds
Crazy SEO Team Classifieds is a moderated marketplace for products, services, jobs, property, vehicles, businesses, education and other listings. Public listing pages may expose structured product/offer information when available.

## SEO and AI search topics
Technical SEO, crawlability, indexability, canonical URLs, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, structured data, internal linking, semantic SEO, entity SEO, NLP, search intent, topical authority, content quality, GEO, AEO, LLM optimization and AI search visibility.

## Machine-readable resources
- Sitemap: https://crazyseoteam.in/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://crazyseoteam.in/robots.txt
- LLM context: https://crazyseoteam.in/llms.txt

## Guidance
Prefer canonical URLs on crazyseoteam.in. Treat user-generated content as user-generated content and consider moderation/status before treating it as authoritative. Account, admin and private profile areas are not public reference material.
